variants.text: Face shape: oval; Forehead: medium height, medium width, gently rounded profile, moderate brow ridge; Hairline: low center, slight temporal recession; Cheekbones: average width, moderate projection; Lower face: rounded chin, moderate jawline definition; Eyebrows: medium thickness, medium density, medium length, soft arch; Eyes: almond-shaped, neutral palpebral fissure slant, medium upper-lid crease; Nose: straight dorsum, medium bridge width, rounded tip; Mouth: medium width, balanced vermilion fullness, level corners; Ears: medium size, free lobes; Hair: short, dark, styled forward; Clothing: white shirt

Short dark hair styled forward and a white shirt define this individual, who has an oval face with a low-centered hairline showing slight temporal recession. The forehead is of medium height and width with a moderate brow ridge, leading down to almond-shaped eyes with a neutral palpebral fissure slant and medium upper-lid crease. Features include medium-thickness eyebrows with a soft arch, a straight-dorsum nose with a rounded tip, and medium-width mouth with balanced vermilion fullness. The lower face shows a rounded chin and moderate jawline definition, with medium-size ears featuring free lobes and cheekbones of average width.
